single_qwen_vl_v3.label: v3 terse single-shot Qwen3-VL, remote Runpod GPU, 896 px

qwen_vl._id_note: llama-server ignores the request's model field and serves whatever -m loaded, so 'qwen-vl' is a label for the results file, matching eval/serve/models.json. If the pod runs vLLM or any server that validates the model id, change this to the id that /v1/models reports.
qwen_vl._max_tokens_note: 256 is headroom, not a target (V3-DESIGN.md §2): the terse grammar bounds output at ~155 completion tokens, and a cap set AT the budget truncates mid-JSON and returns HTTP 200 with an unparseable body. use_json_schema true requires the server to honour response_format json_schema -- llama-server compiles it to GBNF; verify on the pod build before a full run.
